source_inventory_scope: Every file beneath study_root, keyed by relative POSIX path and hashed as raw bytes before audit; the final inventory must match.

comparison_policy.exact: Raw SHA-256 identities, literal tensor edits, rational certificate arithmetic, integer counts, receipt/link schemas and validation selection fractions.

numerical.scope: Independent NumPy forward, metrics and bootstrap comparisons; deterministic TS sequential fixture scores separately require zero error.

comparison_policy.bootstrapping: Only resampling of saved independent endpoint units; no new experimental units or reserved experiment seed executions.
comparison_policy.historical_sources: Authoritative freeze/sources copies and hashes are mandatory; current workspace differences are informational.

details.scope: Historical copied sources are authoritative; later workspace changes do not invalidate an old study.
Inspected archived mission initialization spawns one completed town center per team; no checkpoint regeneration or formal TS proof.

provenance.timestamp_scope: Local self-recorded sequence; no external preregistration or tamper-proof timestamp.

effect.method: percentile bootstrap of paired unit differences
percentile bootstrap of paired unit differences

target_gain_fraction.method: percentile bootstrap of paired unit differences

synthetic.useful_and_admitted_scope: Descriptive: per-program test gain >=0.5 of requested shift and exact admission; denominator includes every planned source program. H2 predeclared a mean gain rule, not this per-program endpoint.
synthetic.negative_control_scope: Raw-permuted error is reported per unit; its magnitude is not part of the frozen aggregate controls_pass rule.
synthetic.inference_scope: Disjoint initialization units, conditional on one saved shared data partition; exploratory unadjusted intervals.

rts_export.scope: pass requires exact sequential scores/choices and close NumPy scores; NumPy argmax mismatches are reported separately; no IEEE proof
rts_export.feature_scope: Re-evaluates saved vectors and recorded ranks; no simulation, legality or state-to-feature extraction replay.

rts_candidates.scope: Exact rational score-drift admission on declared feature boxes; no claim that admission implies better strategy or utility.

rts_development.checkpoint_scope: Raw records preserve final checkpoint digests, but initial checkpoint bodies and default final checkpoint bodies were not saved. Hash link consistency is checked; absent bodies cannot be rehashed or independently replayed.

rts_validation.checkpoint_scope: Raw records preserve final checkpoint digests, but initial checkpoint bodies and default final checkpoint bodies were not saved. Hash link consistency is checked; absent bodies cannot be rehashed or independently replayed.

rts_selection.selection_scope: Reconstructed solely from saved validation raw branch metrics with exact rational means of binary64 utility values; timestamps and linkage are local evidence, not proof of no unseen earlier runs.

rts_test.checkpoint_scope: Raw records preserve final checkpoint digests, but initial checkpoint bodies and default final checkpoint bodies were not saved. Hash link consistency is checked; absent bodies cannot be rehashed or independently replayed.

effect.method: percentile bootstrap of paired unit differences

rts_hypothesis.scope: Single mission, one frozen opponent, net town-HP loss and completed-recruitment utility proxy, finite horizon. Equal observed losses are not statistical noninferiority.
rts_hypothesis.baseline_selection_scope: When baseline wins validation, test evaluates that selected unchanged policy and both controls; it provides no test effect estimate for an edited policy.

limitations: Internal hash consistency and local timestamps do not authenticate authorship or establish external preregistration or absence of unrecorded experiments.

No training, seeded dataset/gauge generation, compilation optimization, alignment optimization or game simulation is rerun. Saved edits and gauge applications are reconstructed; reported losses and endpoints are recomputed.
Exact rational certificates are independently recalculated for saved binary64 parameters; this script does not invoke Lean or establish IEEE floating-point semantic equivalence.
Synthetic inference uses disjoint initialization units conditional on the single shared saved data partition; the three exploratory intervals are unadjusted for multiplicity.
Source useful-and-admitted fractions are descriptive per-program endpoints; the predeclared H2 useful-gain condition concerns the mean gain.
RTS fixtures establish scores and ranks on saved feature vectors, without re-extracting features or replaying legality from snapshots.

RTS initial checkpoint bodies and default final checkpoint bodies are absent. Their recorded digests can be linked but not recomputed; raw production metrics cannot be independently recovered from absent states.
The 1800-HP utility denominator is corroborated by inspected frozen mission initialization and exported snapshots, not by regenerating unsaved initial worlds or formally proving TypeScript.
Successful order histories are saved, but complete per-decision histories including waits/rejected commands are not. First-change records are structurally checked and linked, not fully replayed.

RTS effects apply only to the selected policy, one mission/ruleset, frozen opponent and declared utility proxy. Equal observed losses are not statistical noninferiority; baseline selection provides no held-out effect estimate for an edited policy.
